description: Convert an annual salary into hourly, daily, weekly, biweekly and monthly pay based on your work schedule.

faqs.a: It divides your annual salary by 52 to get the weekly rate, then derives the rest from your hours-per-week and days-per-week. It assumes every week is identical.
Gross pay before income tax, social security and any deductions. Actual take-home pay will be lower.
faqs.q: Is this gross or net pay?

faqs.a: No — it does not model overtime, bonuses, unpaid leave or variable schedules. It is a simple rate conversion.
faqs.q: Does it account for overtime or bonuses?

howto: Enter how many hours you work per week.
Enter how many days you work per week.
Read your equivalent hourly, daily, weekly, biweekly and monthly pay.
title: Salary to Hourly Calculator
